source_title: Manoj Tiwari took a dip in the yamuna… but the internet had a few notes - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt: BJP MP Manoj Tiwari took a dip in the Yamuna at Sonia Vihar, claiming that pollution levels in the river had reduced by 50% over the past year. However, people questioned his choice of location, asking why he did not visit Kalindi Kunj near Okhla Barrage. Meanwhile, DPCC data reveals how the Yamuna's water quality changes as it flows through Delhi, with pollution levels rising sharply at several downstream locations.
